## Checklist

- [ ] One task, atomic commits, Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:cov` (100%) and `npm run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] `openapi/openapi.json` regenerated when the contract changed
- [ ] Behavior verified by running it
- [ ] README and ADRs updated when touched
- [ ] No secret, real data or personal data in code, tests, logs or events
